extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writing commercial film screenplays using the Save the Cat approach; explains core elements such as genre, plot, structure, marketability, and casting in an accessible way for novices. The book also illustrates its points with examples of 'successful' films used by industry practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: 类型 (genre)
rubrics_metrics.description: Treat genre as a primary organising/practical criterion for designing a screenplay.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the page blurb: the book '揭开电影的神秘面纱, 正面地做出解释(类型, 情节, 结构, 市场, 选演员等)'. Genre is listed as one of the core elements the book explains and uses in its practical guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 情节 (plot)
rubrics_metrics.description: Focus on the construction and clarity of plot as a central element of a successful screenplay.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed in the book summary among the principal topics the guide explains to demystify film storytelling for readers (情节).

rubrics_metrics.name: 结构 (structure)
rubrics_metrics.description: Employ clear screenplay structure (beat/structural organization) as a key criterion for effective scripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structure is explicitly named in the blurb (结构) as a core topic the book positively explains; the title Save the Cat is known for a beat-based structure approach, and the page indicates structure is a central concern.

rubrics_metrics.name: 市场 (market/marketability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider market factors and commercial viability when crafting a screenplay.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The blurb lists 市场 (market) among the elements explained, indicating guidance on how market considerations affect screenplay decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 选演员 (casting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Account for casting choices/considerations as part of screenplay development and production thinking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 选演员 (casting) appears in the listed explanatory topics, showing the book treats casting as a practical factor to consider.

rubrics_metrics.name: 引用成功影片例证 (use of successful film examples)
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrate principles with examples of films that industry practitioners consider 'successful'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page notes the book '灵活地引用了电影公司主观门使用的各类"成功"片例' — it uses real-world 'successful' film examples from how film companies evaluate hits to make its points concrete.

rubrics_metrics.name: 易于理解和实践 (accessibility for novices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Present advice in a way that beginners and supportive practitioners can understand and apply in practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The blurb states the book is written '以一种新手和支持者能够理解并帮助实践的方式', i.e., deliberately accessible and practical for newcomers.
